flags.headword: được làm vua, thua làm giặc
flags.why: “Winner takes all” replaces the proverb's meaning that victory determines who is considered right with a claim about taking everything ([reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/thắng_làm_vua,_thua_làm_giặc)).
flags.fix: The two companies compete fiercely; it really is a case of the winner being deemed right and the loser wrong.

flags.why: “Xếp hàng dài” describes a long queue, not a long waiting time.
flags.fix: Visitors form a long queue to visit this grand cathedral.
